integrity: Analytic proof uses exact support maxima, a definite integral, compact moment determinacy and convexity under reflection. Standalone deterministic regression tests supplement but do not substitute for proof. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Full response curve of exact mean unlabeled widths for known height and centered homothety; identifies only support-value distribution, not angular arrangement or base congruence. No finite-sample statistical guarantees, stability modulus or finite-taper sufficiency. Qualitative convex order may follow classical shadow-system convexity; historical priority for the exact arctangent transform remains provisional.
title: Taper-response tomography for homothetic convex frusta
